question: What is the value of 44 ÷ 11 × 4 + 5 × 8 ÷ 4 - 7 × 36 ÷ 14 + 7 × 4 ?
solution:
**Given:**

44 ÷ 11 × 4 + 5 × 8 ÷ 4 - 7 × 36 ÷ 14 + 7 × 4

**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/Wq7kx18hNKDzgovxhqy2A-VL43akf5V73ps1_hxlYqw55bWjt-V_9k_mWXOTUv5171eEVni0EIwcYRsOwVKOX4MDuJUan5mYztd5pdmJvp6NHETvy73lF1WN6WlNahCExWvKaJjKgG0VbPksPIBqCw8] 

Calculation:

44 ÷ 11 × 4 + 5 × 8 ÷ 4 - 7 × 36 ÷ 14 + 7 × 4

⇒ 4 × 4 + 5 × 2 - 18 + 7 × 4

⇒ 16 + 10 - 18 + 28

⇒ 54 - 18

⇒ 36

**∴ The value is 36.**
